_trn_window_close_text_1: Closing the app will prevent some features from working properly.
_trn_window_close_text_2: You can also <0>customize the default game launch behavior</0>.
_trn_window_close_restart_title: Are you sure you want to restart?
_trn_window_close_stops_servers: Local servers that are running will be stopped, and players on them disconnected.
_trn_window_close_stops_installs: Downloads and installs in progress will be cancelled. You can start them again afterwards.
_trn_window_close_game_keeps_running: The game keeps running, but some features will not work properly until GDLauncher is opened again.
